hero.text: Explore complete books and ebooks published by RCF Publications for students, teachers and English learners.

blocks.title: Books, not resource packs
text: This section lists **complete published titles**: books, ebooks, published study guides and teacher manuals published as books.
Downloadable collections of worksheets, lesson plans and model papers are a different thing, and they live in [Premium Resources](premium-resources/).
Before you buy, please read the [Terms and Conditions](rcf-publications/terms/) and the [Refund and Return Policy](rcf-publications/refund-policy/) of RCF Publications.

blocks.heading: Why an ebook
blocks.eyebrow: What you get that print cannot give you
intro: A comprehensive printed resource is expensive to produce and awkward to carry. These titles give you the same teaching and learning material at a fraction of the cost, and add several things a printed book simply cannot do.

items.title: Clickable contents
text: The contents page is live. Click a poem, a topic or a sub-topic and you are taken straight to it - no page-turning, no index at the back.
bullets: Every entry is a link
A Home button on each page returns you to the contents
Find any section in one tap

items.title: No watermark
text: The pages are supplied clean. Nothing is stamped across the text, so the book is comfortable to read on screen and clear to print.
bullets: Readable on a phone
Prints without a grey wash
Comfortable for long study sessions

items.title: Print only what you need
text: Print or photocopy the pages for a particular lesson rather than carrying a whole book, subject to the copyright terms.
bullets: Useful for lesson preparation
One poem or one section at a time
No need to buy multiple copies

items.title: Affordable
text: A printed book of the same depth would cost several times as much. Most titles here are **Rs. 500/=**.
bullets: No printing or delivery cost
Same material, lower price
Buy more than one for the price of a single printed book

items.title: Delivered immediately
text: There is no waiting for a courier and nothing to collect. The file arrives and you can start using it the same day.
bullets: Useful when a lesson is tomorrow
Nothing to go out of stock
Keep a copy on every device you use

items.title: Searchable
text: Use your reader's search to find a quotation, a technique or a poet's name anywhere in the book in a moment.
bullets: Search the whole book at once
Jump between related sections
Nothing to flick through

blocks.heading: School English support books
text: Grade-by-grade companions for pupils who have fallen behind and need to rebuild English without falling further behind.

blocks.heading: Grammar and examination support
text: Grammar practice and quick reference for the Ordinary Level.

blocks.heading: Advanced Level General English
text: General English for the G.C.E. Advanced Level: Paper I and Paper II, worked through question by question.

blocks.heading: Spoken English
text: Ready-to-run spoken English lessons for the primary classroom.

blocks.heading: Literature study guides
text: Full study guides to prescribed texts, with examination guidance and model answers.

blocks.heading: Professional and workplace English
text: English for particular kinds of work, for adults already in a job or preparing for one.

blocks.heading: Teacher-development books
text: Books written for teachers rather than pupils.

pages.title: Refund and Return Policy
pages.metaTitle: Refund and Return Policy | RCF Publications | RCF English
pages.description: The refund and return policy of RCF Publications for ebooks and other digital educational materials: when a refund or replacement may be given, and how to ask for one.
pages.keywords: RCF Publications refund policy, ebook refund, digital product returns

blocks.heading: About this policy
text: RCF Publications provides educational books, ebooks, learning resources and other digital educational materials to customers.

blocks.heading: Digital products
text: Due to the nature of digital products, purchases of ebooks and other downloadable digital materials are generally non-refundable once the product has been delivered or access has been provided.
Before purchasing, customers are encouraged to review the product description and confirm that the selected product is suitable for their requirements.
A refund or replacement may be considered in the following circumstances:
bullets: The customer was charged more than once for the same product due to a payment error.
The customer paid for a product but did not receive the purchased digital product because of a technical problem.
The delivered file is materially defective or corrupted and cannot be reasonably corrected or replaced.
RCF Publications makes an error in delivering a product different from the one purchased.

text: Where appropriate, RCF Publications may provide a replacement copy or an alternative solution instead of a monetary refund.

blocks.heading: Refund requests
text: Customers should contact RCF Publications as soon as possible after identifying a problem and provide the payment details and relevant information about the purchase.
Each request will be reviewed individually. If a refund is approved, it will normally be processed through the original payment method, subject to the applicable payment provider's procedures.

text: Welcome to RCF Publications. By purchasing or using products and services provided by RCF Publications, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

blocks.heading: 1. About RCF Publications
text: RCF Publications provides educational books, ebooks, English language learning materials, grammar practice resources, teacher support materials and other educational content.

blocks.heading: 2. Products and services
text: Product descriptions, prices and availability may be changed or updated from time to time.
Digital products are supplied electronically. Customers are responsible for providing accurate contact information necessary to receive their purchased products.

blocks.heading: 3. Payments
text: Payments for products and services may be processed through third-party payment providers, including PayHere and other available payment methods.
A purchase is considered completed once the payment has been successfully received and confirmed.

blocks.heading: 4. Digital products
text: Unless otherwise stated, ebooks and other digital educational materials are supplied for the purchaser's personal educational use.
The purchaser must not reproduce, resell, redistribute, upload, share publicly or commercially exploit any RCF Publications material without prior written permission.

blocks.heading: 5. Copyright
text: All books, ebooks, text, graphics, designs and other original materials published by RCF Publications are protected by applicable copyright laws.
Purchasing a digital product does not transfer copyright ownership to the purchaser.

blocks.heading: 6. Educational purpose
text: Our educational materials are designed to support learning and teaching. They are provided as educational resources and should not be considered a guarantee of a particular examination result, qualification or academic outcome.

blocks.heading: 7. Refunds
text: Refunds and replacement requests are handled according to our [Refund and Return Policy](rcf-publications/refund-policy/).

Because digital products can be copied or accessed immediately after delivery, digital purchases are generally non-refundable once the product has been delivered, except where an eligible problem occurs.

blocks.heading: 8. Website information
text: We make reasonable efforts to ensure that information published on our website is accurate and up to date. However, errors or omissions may occasionally occur, and information may be corrected or updated without prior notice.

blocks.heading: 9. Privacy
text: Personal information submitted through our website or during purchases is handled in accordance with our [Privacy Policy](privacy/).

blocks.heading: 10. Changes to these terms
text: RCF Publications reserves the right to update these Terms and Conditions when necessary. The latest version will be published on this website.
